bind.description: IP address or hostname to bind the service to. Use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces.

cache_max_size.description: Maximum size of the in-memory cache. Accepts unit suffixes like KiB, MiB, GiB, or raw bytes (e.g., '512MiB').

config_path.description: Absolute path to the main dqcache configuration file (YAML or JSON).

extra_flags.description: Additional command-line flags to pass to dqcache. Each key is a flag name (without leading -), value can be a string, number, or boolean (true = flag present, false = omitted).

items.description: Value for the flag. Boolean true includes the flag (e.g., -insecure); false omits it.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging: one of 'debug', 'info', 'warn', 'error'. Lower levels produce more verbose logs.

port.description: TCP port on which the dqcache service listens for incoming connections.

run_dir.description: Directory where dqcache stores runtime files (e.g., PID file, sockets). Must be writable by the service user.

user.description: System user account under which the dqcache process should run (for security isolation).

worker_count.description: Number of worker goroutines to handle requests concurrently. Adjust based on CPU cores and load.
